use_case_summary: Primary workloads: embeddings for transaction vectorization (batch and realtime), reranking to surface high-confidence results in risk models, and a constrained chat assistant for merchant support. Targets: p95 latency < 80ms for small embedding requests (128 dims), p99 latency < 250ms for 512-token chat responses under steady-state traffic. Throughput target: sustained 200 req/s for scoring endpoints during peak windows, burst to 1000 req/s for 5-minute windows. Cost sensitivity: medium-high; wants predictable reserved-pricing model plus measurable per-token delta for bursts. Model preferences: open model family with low-latency variants and support for quantized execution; fallback routing to smaller models for graceful degradation. Security/compliance: end-to-end encryption at rest and in transit, audit logs retained 12 months, SSO/SAML enforced for console access, regional data residency (NA).
poc_plan: Baseline perf run (72h): 8x A100-equivalent nodes, default compilation kernels, measure steady-state p95/p99 + GPU utilization
Load ramp tests: 0 -> 200 req/s over 30m, hold 2h, spike tests to 1000 req/s for 5m windows
Soak test: 72-hour steady workload at 80% of target throughput to validate stability and memory/KV cache behavior
Representative prompt validation: run full prompt set (50 variants) across node pool, validate quality/regression vs control model
Failure scenarios: simulate node loss and validate automatic fallback routing to hosted model variant (failover < 10s) and circuit-breaker behavior
Success criteria: sustained p99 < 250ms for chat at target throughput, no data-plane errors >0.5%, stable GPU mem usage with KV-cache hit-rate >60%
Operational handoff: create runbook, dashboard template (per-route latency/cost), RBAC + SSO test, and final cost projection for reserved capacity
